articles_public_published_at.name: articles_public_published_at
articles_public_published_at.value: "articles"."status" not in ('published', 'corrected') or "articles"."published_at" is not null

email_campaigns_approved.name: email_campaigns_approved
email_campaigns_approved.value: "email_campaigns"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or "email_campaigns"."kind" = 'newsletter' or "email_campaigns"."approved_by" is not null

facebook_posts_posted.name: facebook_posts_posted
facebook_posts_posted.value: "facebook_posts"."status" <> 'posted' or ("facebook_posts"."posted_at" is not null and "facebook_posts"."method" is not null)

photo_submissions_approved.name: photo_submissions_approved
photo_submissions_approved.value: "photo_submissions"."status" <> 'approved' or ("photo_submissions"."alt" is not null and "photo_submissions"."reviewed_by" is not null)

score_reports_approved.name: score_reports_approved
score_reports_approved.value: "score_reports"."status" <> 'approved' or ("score_reports"."reviewed_by" is not null and "score_reports"."record_id" is not null)
